description.value: Gain trials in which a geometric cue signaled the possibility of gaining €1; participants responded as fast as possible to the target. A successful response yielded a €1 gain and an unsuccessful response yielded no gain.

loss
loss trial

description.value: Loss trials in which a geometric cue signaled the possibility of losing €1; participants responded as fast as possible to the target. A successful response avoided the loss and yielded €0, whereas an unsuccessful response resulted in a €1 loss.
